summary: 91 publish, 15 publish_flagged, 1 reject across 107 entities. Rejected: site:ims-japan. Systemic issues: five APS citations refused access; undated live product/roadmap pages use access dates; several operator fields describe an owner or institutional host rather than an explicitly named technical operator; vendor fidelity figures require definition-specific treatment; and target outcomes cannot be inferred from later dates. Corrections remove unsupported tickers and Sqale's 1,600-atom-to-qubit equivalence, change AC1000 to announced, date Aquila's 256-qubit figure to the dated 2026 source, detach the IMS system from the invalid site record, repair mathematical/CZ quote extraction, and return Pasqal's HPCQS target from missed to open.
